answers.how: The trolley is approximately 100 px long. Its measured pixel acceleration is about 132 px/s², giving a scale of 1.507/132 m/px.
The trolley spans approximately 110 px vertically; multiplying by the acceleration-derived scale of 1.507/132 m/px gives its height.
The entrance doorway, including its gold outer frame, spans approximately 404 px vertically. Using 1.507/132 m/px gives its height.
An orange tile's horizontal side is approximately 50 px. Multiplying by 1.507/132 m/px gives its side length.
The trolley's position follows an approximately quadratic trajectory from rest. Its measured velocity at 1 s converts to 1.507 m/s using the acceleration-derived scale.
The quadratic motion gives twice the 1-second velocity at 2 s, yielding 3.014 m/s.
